title: The Singing Vein
text: A vein of crystal runs through the rock, pale blue and glowing faintly. It rings like glass when touched, and the whole tunnel hums with it, a long low note that settles in the bones. Something deeper in the rock hums back.

outcomes.text: Crystal that holds essence, ringing in the sack.
The hum becomes a shriek, and the tunnel answers.

options.label: The keenest ear listens to it.

outcomes.text: It echoes the shape of the tunnels ahead, and you know the way.
The hum follows you a while, soothing, until the deeper hum takes over.
